reference_classification.slower_case_policy: All original-successful declared cases remain eligible regardless of later measured speed; originalerrors retained untimed.

geometric_mean.formula: Ascending occupied bins: weighted sum of C log(i+1); exp(sum/pop)-1; interpolation helper rounds positive values by truncating(value+0.5), then integer cast to output. Empty population gives0.
geometric_mean.signature: (image, footprint, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, shift_z=0)

noise_filter.formula: Copied footprint center cleared before common preprocessing. If g is present then0; else min distance to first occupied lower/upper bin, falling back to bins0 andcapacity-1 when a side is absent, including empty populations.
noise_filter.signature: (image, footprint, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, shift_z=0)

subtract_mean.formula: Ascending weighted integer sum S; ((g-S/pop)/2 + floor(histogram_capacity/2))-1, in this floating operation order; cast to fused output. Empty population gives0.
subtract_mean.signature: (image, footprint, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, shift_z=0)

windowed_histogram.formula: For each requested output channel i: count[i] * (1.0/pop), then fused output cast; empty population gives0. Capacity and output depth are independent.
windowed_histogram.signature: (image, footprint, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, n_bins=None)

safety.subtract_u16_integer_output: Even prepared capacity and algebraically bounded truncation range certified before upstream; unproved unsigned domains excluded, never probed
